title: Login Flow
description: Accessible sign-in form with credentials fields, error feedback for failed attempts, and recovery links.

components.reason: Root form context for credential inputs

components.label: Username or email
components.reason: Instantiate twice: once for username (autocomplete='username'), once for password (type='password', autocomplete='current-password')

components.label: Sign in
components.reason: Primary submit action; the only primary button on the page

components.label: Forgot password?
components.reason: Recovery path placed below the form
Rendered above the form only when authentication fails

nesting: Components 2-3 are children of component 1 (button last); component 4 is a sibling below the form; component 5 sits above component 1 when present
validationOrder: On authentication failure, show the error alert with a generic message
a11yNotes: Password field must have type='password' and an associated label
Error alert must use role='alert' so screen readers announce failures
Do not disable the submit button while typing; validate on submit
agentPromptSequence: 1. Fetch the form tile (order 1) as the page's root container
2. Instantiate text-input twice inside the form: username then password
3. Add the sign-in button as the last child of the form
4. Add the recovery link below the form
5. Conditionally render the error alert above the form on failed sign-in
